label: DIVERGENCE FLAG
material_proposition: The400k compact offer is materially below contemporary comparable value.
observed_evidence: Contemporary mixed-size transaction summary centres near400k, whereas older larger/high-floor examples reach580/600k.
contradicting_judgment: An apparent low-entry opportunity based on older high references; this is an analyst test, not an attributed new user judgement.

possible_explanations.data_limitation: Mixed sizes/floors, masked individual prices, lag and stale listing references.
possible_explanations.judgment_bias: Anchoring to old high transactions and choosing favourable comparables.
possible_explanations.omitted_variable: Low floor, condition, bay rights, tenancy/short-stay package or governance burden.
possible_explanations.structural_change: Actual reduction in clearing willingness-to-pay; not demonstrated by changing aggregate medians alone.

falsifiable_hypothesis: The apparent large discount mainly reflects mismatched period/product references rather than recoverable mispricing.
evidence_required: Contemporaneous600-624sf ordinary transfers with floor/condition/package context; comparable low-floor asks only as supply checks.
falsification_conditions: Matched ordinary sales persist materially above400k after supported adjustments, with identified temporary seller-specific cause and recoverable costs.
implication: No discount booked; no conviction uplift or lower margin of safety. More evidence is required.
